# automorphism group　`def.automorphism-group`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.automorphism-group)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.automorphism-group.md)

For $g \in G$, the map $c_g(x) := gxg^{-1}$ is an automorphism, an **inner automorphism**; all inner automorphisms

$\operatorname{Inn}(G) := \{\, c_g : g \in G \,\} \trianglelefteq \operatorname{Aut}(G)$

form a normal subgroup, and $\operatorname{Inn}(G) \cong G/Z(G)$. The quotient $\operatorname{Out}(G) := \operatorname{Aut}(G)/\operatorname{Inn}(G)$ is the **outer automorphism group**.
